buckets.METADATA_ONLY_STUB: Explicit METADATA_ONLY/POINTER_ONLY flag, or no inline code, diff, PoC, prose >=100 chars and no formal spec.
buckets.FULLY_TRAINABLE: Inline code >=50 chars AND inline technical prose >=100 chars, with no explicit metadata flag.
buckets.PARTIAL_TEXT_NO_CODE: Has inline prose >=100 chars, PoC or formal spec text, but no inline target source code or unified diff.
buckets.invalid: Non-dict or unparseable JSON lines; counted separately and never bucketed.

hydration.HYDRATABLE_FROM_LOCAL_WORK: A work/sources/ or local clone-dir path pointer exists (priority 1).
hydration.HYDRATABLE_FROM_GIT_OR_GITHUB: A GitHub URL/repo/commit/PR/issue, GHSA, CVE or 40-hex SHA pointer exists (priority 2).
hydration.UNHYDRATABLE_DEAD_POINTER: Only PDF/advisory/placeholder pointers or no pointer at all.
hydration.file_summary_scope: Per-file counts cover stub+partial rows only; the global summary covers all bucketed rows.

notes: Detection walks every string value recursively; known field paths are additionally recognised.
code_reference_only pointer objects have no snippet and are never counted as inline code.
invariants[].invariant natural-language text is only counted as a formal spec when CVL markers are present.
METADATA_ONLY/POINTER_ONLY must be an exact value (or in a known flag field); the words inside input_text are not flags.
